title: Busao topete preso
premise: Gersinho dança brega no degrau da porta do ônibus; a porta sanfonada fecha e prende a ponta do topete pra fora, e ele fica parado, sério, olhando a lente pelo vidro.
gag_without_sound: a porta fecha e a ponta do topete gigante fica presa pra fora, e ele nem pisca

location.place: ponto de ônibus de bairro com ônibus urbano parado

camera.height: altura do peito, a 3 m, do outro lado da calçada

beats.action: no degrau de baixo da porta dianteira aberta, faz o passo brega: peso de um pé pro outro no tempo, quadril balançando, indicador subindo e descendo
as duas folhas de vidro fecham das laterais para o centro e prendem a ponta do topete na emenda; ele fica parado, sério, encarando a lente pelo vidro

end_state: porta fechada, ponta do topete presa pra fora na emenda das folhas, rosto sério visto pelo vidro, dedo pra cima

props.name: porta dianteira sanfonada do ônibus
props.orientation: folhas de vidro dobradas nas duas laterais da porta; fecham das laterais para o centro

storyboard_panels.description: pose de assinatura no degrau, porta aberta
pico do passo brega, quadril para a esquerda do quadro
folhas de vidro fechando das laterais para o centro, a ponta do topete passando da linha da porta
porta fechada, ponta do topete presa pra fora na emenda, rosto sério pelo vidro

start_frame: Gersinho no degrau de baixo da porta dianteira aberta de um ônibus urbano lotado, de frente para a câmera, dedo pra cima, mão na barriga, topete inteiro visível
end_frame: porta fechada, ponta do topete presa pra fora na emenda das folhas de vidro, rosto sério visto pelo vidro

music.trend_sound_hint: brega romântico em alta no Reels BR

caption: O busão não estava preparado para tanto estilo.
originality_note: primeira piada de veículo; gag de escala do topete
risks: o topete dobrar ao fechar a porta; o modelo cortar a cena; a porta abrir para o lado errado. Conferir no storyboard o painel 3.

en.gag_sentence: At a São Paulo bus stop he does his signature brega step on the lowest step of a bus doorway until the two folding glass door leaves close and pinch the front tip of his rigid pompadour, which stays sticking out through the seam between them.
en.location: the open front doorway of a white-and-green city bus stopped at a bus stop in a working-class São Paulo neighborhood, worn concrete sidewalk, a bus-stop shelter and a graffiti wall, overcast late afternoon
en.location_map: Frame-left: the bus body, its windows showing four passengers. Center: the open front doorway with three steps; its two glass door leaves folded open, one against the left side and one against the right side of the doorway. Frame-right: the bus-stop shelter and a graffiti wall. Foreground: worn concrete sidewalk.
en.position: on the lowest step of the open front doorway, centered, chest square to the lens, his face 5 cm behind the door line; the front of the pompadour leans 10 cm forward past the door line, its top just below the top of the door frame
en.signature_pose: left hand flat on his belly, right index finger raised beside his head, feet together on the step
en.extras_tasks: three seated passengers inside read their phones, one passenger by the window looks out at the street, one pedestrian walks along the sidewalk from frame-right to frame-left looking ahead
en.props: exactly one bus front door made of two glass leaves, folded open against the left and right sides of the doorway
en.hands: He has exactly two hands: left hand flat on his belly, right hand with the index finger raised.

stages.text: He holds the signature pose from the start frame on the lowest step; breathing lifts the chest, one slow blink.
stages.end_state: same pose, eyes into the lens.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

stages.text: Real-time, at 95 BPM: he shifts his weight onto his left foot, heel first; his hips sway once to frame-left and once to frame-right on the beat; his raised right index finger moves up and down twice on the beat; his left hand stays flat on his belly.
stages.end_state: feet together, finger raised, chest square to the lens.
stages.facing: chest within 30° of the lens while the hips sway, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

stages.text: The two glass door leaves swing closed from the left and right sides of the doorway toward the center, in front of his body; their vertical edges meet in the center and pinch the front tip of the pompadour that sticks out past the door line; the tip stays outside the closed door, its outline unchanged; he keeps the pose.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens through the glass
stages.end_state: door closed, the pompadour tip pinched in the seam and sticking out toward the lens, his face behind the glass.

stages.text: Everything settles and holds; he stares into the lens through the glass, finger raised. The final frame matches the end frame.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens through the glass
stages.end_state: door closed, pompadour tip pinched outside the seam, deadpan face behind the glass.

en.end_change: the two glass door leaves are closed in front of him, meeting in the center of the doorway; the front tip of the rigid black pompadour sticks out 10 cm toward the lens through the seam between the leaves, pinched, outline unchanged; his deadpan face is seen through the glass with the right index finger raised
en.end_props: the door is fully closed, both glass leaves meeting in the center of the doorway
en.props_lock: Exactly one bus door with two glass leaves: open at both sides in the first frame, closed in the center in the last frame, pinching the pompadour tip.
en.lighting: Overcast late-afternoon daylight from the open sky, soft even light, gentle shadows under the bus, 5600K.
